short: Text-free synthesis is shown, but its real time is throughput, not causal synthesis, unseen-sentence WER is 2.3 times the cascade, and intelligibility rests on ratings and ASR.
position: The paper changes the processing (a phoneme bottleneck with deep-HMM alignment into a TTS latent space) and the output (a pretrained VITS decoder). The output interface is standard: its effect rests on one participant and one run. The authors' real time is throughput (RTF 0.532); on causality the processing is behind the field: the alignment uses evidence up to the end of the utterance, whereas causal intracortical synthesis already plays audio within 10 ms. On unseen sentences WER is 0.472 against 0.206 for the 5-gram plus LLM cascade, and seen-data parity is a training-fit result. Intelligibility rests on a 1–5 rating and Whisper WER rather than listener transcription, which 29 text-verified synthesis studies use.
